name: Sandbag Ballast Kit for Event Tent Legs (Set of Four)
descriptionHtml:
📦 Sandbag Ballast Kit for Event Tent Legs (Set of Four)

  • Keep your tent weighted down for stability. Compatible with all our tent frames. Straps around event tent legs to keep the tent weighted down. Set includes four ballasts. Each ballast has two zippered pockets for sand. Weighs 20.6 lbs. when filled with sand. Complies with Prop 65. 12.5" D x 14.5" W x 4.75" H
